title: Finite constant models in localized pro-etale sites
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and F a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on X_proet. Suppose a pro-etale covering family g_i:W_i$\to$X makes g_i^*F a constant sheaf with a finite module value M_i. Then there is a covering family U_i$\to$X in the small pro-etale site such that F.over(U_i) is the constant M_i-valued sheaf on the localized site. Here inverse images are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] and covers those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: Each covering map is weakly etale. Regard W_i as an object U_i of the small site; the same arrows to its terminal object form a covering family.

Use [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] to identify the slice site with the source small site. Scheme pullback is localized restriction by uniqueness of left adjoints. Constants correspond under the equivalence, so transport the supplied isomorphism back to the slice. Finite module values remain unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteModels_over
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((g i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt)
      (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)),
      Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ ProEt.precoverage X (ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)) ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (F.over (U i) ≅
            (constantSheaf ((ProEt.topology X).over (U i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
